gloss: to gather; to pick; to collect; to adopt

definitions.gloss: to gather; to pick; to collect; to harvest
definitions.explanation: To pick or gather natural things like plants, mushrooms, shellfish, or minerals from their environment.

definitions.gloss: to adopt; to choose; to employ
definitions.explanation: To select and adopt a plan, method, or person. Used for hiring, selecting candidates, or adopting approaches.

examples.english: To gather mushrooms in the mountains.
I picked some flowers from the garden.

notes:
One of several とる verbs distinguished by kanji. {採|と}る specifically means to pick/gather from nature or to select/adopt. The kanji {採|さい} carries the sense of selecting or extracting.

KANJI DISTINCTIONS (とる):
- ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take (general, most common)
- ⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take (photos/video)
- {採|と}る: to gather, to pick; to adopt, to hire
- ⟦{捕|と}る→捕る：28715_toru⟧: to catch (animals, criminals)
- {盗|と}る: to steal

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- きのこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採|と}る: to gather mushrooms
- ⟦{山菜|さんさい}→山菜：12404_sansai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採|と}る: to gather wild vegetables
- ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採|と}る: to draw blood
- ⟦{多数決|たすうけつ}→多数決：16369_tasuuketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採|と}る: to take a vote
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採|と}る: to hire talent
- ⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採|と}る: to adopt a policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take (general-purpose, broadest meaning)
- ⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harvest (agriculture, more formal)
- ⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adopt, to employ (formal, common in business)
